column3: Total loss of the initialization function
column4:
Sensor initialization failure, software error in calibration 
process
column5:
- Ensure that all sensors are calibrated and 
operational before flight. 

- Loss of function should trigger manual takeover.
column6:
- Implement redundant initialization procedures with 
self-checks and alerts to notify the pilot of any 
initialization issues.

column3: Total loss of data collection function
column4: Complete sensor failure or data bus failure
column5:
- Maintain real-time data collection. 

- Immediate alert to the pilot for manual 
intervention if data collection fails.
column6:
- Implement redundant data collection systems with 
cross-verification and immediate alert notifications for 
manual navigation.

column4: Processing module failure, software or hardware error
column5:
- Ensure processed sensor data is accurate and 
noise-free.

- Fallback to manual intervention if 
processing fails.
column6:
- Implement redundant processing systems; error 
detection to notify pilot and switch to alternative data 
if processing fails.

column3: Loss of ability to identify the danger
column5:
- Ensure reliable identification of objects.

- Initiate manual control upon detection loss.
column6:
- Implement redundant identification systems.

- Cross-verification and alert to pilot for immediate 
manual intervention.

column4: Categorization algorithm failure or data corruption
column5:
- Ensure fallback categorization or manual 
override.
 
- Pilot notified of categorization failure.
column6:
- Implement redundant categorization algorithms with 
alerts to pilot for manual categorization when needed.

column3: Loss of ability to detect anomalies
column4: Software malfunction in anomaly detection module
column5:
- Ensure system reliably detects anomalous 
objects.

- Pilot alerted for manual control if detection fails.
column6:
- Redundant anomaly detection algorithms with alerts
and error notifications to pilot to monitor manually.

column3: Loss of ability to calculate position
column5:
- Maintain accurate positioning.

- Notify pilot for immediate manual control if 
calculation fails.
column6:
- Redundant position calculation algorthims with alerts
to pilot to manage navigation if critical positiong issue
is detected.

column4: Velocity estimation algorithm failure or sensor malfunction
column5:
- Ensure accurate velocity data. 

- Notify pilot to take manual control if velocity 
estimation fails.
column6:
- Redundant velocity estimation systems with alerts 
for manual control if velocity estimation fails

column4: Algorithm failure or sensor data loss
column5:
- Ensure pilot is notified for manual takeover 
upon proximity analysis failure.
column6:
- Redundant proximity analysis algorthims with alerts
for manual takeover if system cannot maintain 
accurate proximity data.

column6:
- Redundant threat ranking algorthims with cross-

column3: Loss of ability to priority rank threats
column4: Ranking algorithm failure or data corruption
column5:
- Ensure pilot can manually prioritize threats if
ranking fails.
column6:
- Redundant threat ranking algorithms with cross-
verification and alerts for emergency pilot assessment 
and manual prioritization.

column4: Weather sensor failure or communication loss
column5:
- Provide alerts for manual weather monitoring 
if system loses weather data.
column6:
- Redundant weather sensors with alerts to pilot to 
monitor weather manually if automatic weather 
acquisition fails.

- Redundant terrian mapping systems with alerts to
